text: I highly recommend it for any messy eater or elderly with these .... My mom invariably drops food or liquid on her blouse when eating, she has so many shirts and sweaters stained with speckles from this.  So, I bought her this clip so she could have a napkin right there to catch the drips and dropped particles without the fuss of constantly tucking a napkin into her collar.  She uses it all the time and loves it, carries it in her purse to use in restaurants, even.  I highly recommend it for any messy eater or elderly with these problems!
